description: This file defines the Java interface 'ThingRevision', which represents the current revision of a 'Thing' in the model. It provides a static method to create a new immutable instance with a specified revision number. The interface extends a generic 'Revision' interface parameterized with 'ThingRevision'.

classes.name: ThingRevision
classes.description: Interface representing the current revision of a 'Thing'. It extends Revision and provides a static factory method.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Static factory method that creates a new immutable 'ThingRevision' with the specified revision number.
